Ultimate Fishing Simulator: Pure Relaxation and 100% Completion! After 36 hours of gameplay and finally hitting 142/142 achievements, I can confidently say this is the gold standard for fishing simulators on Steam. It’s the perfect way to unwind and de-stress.Gameplay: Fishing Done Right
The balance between realism and fun is what hooked me. The Struggle: Fighting a trophy-sized fish feels authentic. Managing the drag and line tension is crucial, making every big catch feel earned. Underwater Camera: This is a game-changer. Being able to see the fish's behavior and how they approach the bait makes the experience so much more engaging than a traditional simulator. Huge Variety: From ice fishing in Alaska to sea fishing in the tropics, the diversity of locations and gear keeps things fresh. The Path to 100%
Getting all 142 achievements was a rewarding journey. It pushed me to master different techniques and hunt down rare species like the Black Crappie and Black Drum. It never felt like a mindless grind; it felt like becoming a true virtual angler. Pros & ConsPROS:Stunning Visuals: The water effects and fish models are top-notch. No "Dead Time": You don't have to wait an hour for a bite. The pacing is perfect for a video game. In-depth Equipment: The amount of licensed gear you can customize is impressive. CONS:Boat Physics: Handling the boats can feel a little stiff at times, but it’s a minor nitpick. 
Final Verdict:
Ultimate Fishing Simulator is a masterpiece for fans of the genre. Completing it 100% was a blast, and I still find myself coming back just for the vibes.

Ultimate Fishing Simulator® is a Fishing game co-developed by Pancake Games and Bit Golem.

There are three modes to play: Normal, Realistic and Sandbox. In Normal you get access to an underwater camera, bait indicator and hunter vision. In Realism mode those features are disabled and catch rates are reduced. In Sandbox mode you have access to every equipment, fishery and all skills are unlocked. You play in First Person and can choose to play in singleplayer or multiplayer. You can choose different fishing styles or techniques such as float, spinning, bottom, ice or fly fishing. Choose a hook size, then adjust the bait or lure type. Pay attention to the weather condition and luring method. You can use Straight Slow, Straight, Lift & Drop, Stop & Go or Twitching luring methods. As part of the Aquariums DLC you can see your biggest catches in your trophy room and can set up aquariums with the fish you want to display up to 30 fish and 2000kg max in one tank. If you choose you wish to keep them that's where they'll be located and available to be accessed later. If you want to sell them then you do so from the aquarium options. 

To start off; the map designs are very nice, there are Winter Ice-Fishing variants of several maps. The maps are based on real world locations. The game artwork looks polished. The game mechanics don't feel shallow but aren't frustrating either. It feels good to fight with the fish. You adjust reel speed and drag while managing your line. The animations feel nice and I like seeing how the different lures move. Fish models look nice. Difficulty directly correlates with how good of a set-up you have. Different fish prefer dfferent styles or rigs. You have to adjust how you play to what you want to catch. Sound effects are appropriate. Music is good, there is an in-game online radio feature. UFS is a relaxing and nice way to spend the time. Has a high replayability. Reeling and even waiting feels enjoyable. A good way to unwind when you're not able to fish in real life. Fish behaviour seems realistic, although some glitches do appear occassionally. Really nice to include a fish encyclopedia which includes information about the species, best weather conditions, what they eat and how many specimens you've caught as well as your biggest. There seems a decent amount of realism even down to the fish diet. The game has a day and night cycle. You can set this yourself, for your personal enjoyment. Depends on whichever time is best for you to fish. Game allows for use of a boat and trolling though not every map has this feature. You can switch easily between different rods for fast access, up to 5 different rigs. The help guide is useful for explaining all the features in more detail. It tells you if you should consider switching to a bigger or smaller hook for the area. Every month the leaderboards for each location are reset. You can set up your own tournaments which can have a time limit, goal can be amount of fish, total weight or biggest fish. They can be public or private. Game runs okay but can be a bit slow depending on your graphics settings.

For a few cons to mention; there is no way to choose your avatar. Certain maps have a different first person view model but it doesn't let you choose a model. In multiplayer you appear as a faceless 3d avatar. The colour changes depending on what action you're taking. Some multiplayer features are limited. It would be nice to get more interactive features for example emoticons, a better third person view model, in-game voice chat. As well as visiting each other's trophy rooms / aquariums for those that have the DLC or viewing leaderboards for friends only. The aquariums would benefit with a mode where you can select a fish and see the aquarium from their perspective or free cam for improved viewing pleasure. The biggest problem is some of the UI might seem cluttered. It would be much nicer to be able to see which fish use which bait or lure in an alphabetical order - or even to search by fish so you can just see what you want to buy. It can take a long time to look over which fish prefers which setup, which can feel tedious. Some of the third-party radio stations have long since gone offline and don't function. These should be updated and removed from the game. Some movement feels a bit restrictive i.e. not being able to jump or interact with some items around the map like sitting on chairs, interacting with doors. Fish might not always spawn where you might assume so hunter vision is important. Sometimes line gets glitched. I had a glitch where my line was vibrating very fast when I reeled it out past a certain depth. Sometimes there are underwater camera clipping issues. 

Overall, I believe any fishing enthusiast would be keen to play this game even if it's a bit dated. I'm excited to see the release of the 3rd instalment and the free remaster once development is finalised. The game is good value for money, and the DLCs can add to the experience. They provide more fish to catch, different equipment, locations and even the addition of VR. This game is best enjoyed in a voice chat with friends. Usually we screen share and show off our own catches.

本人55小时完成该游戏并且达到了全图鉴 ，目前还差2个成就分别是钓到1000条鱼和钓到2000条鱼没有完成。总体上看这个游戏难度偏低，但是由于难度过低导致后期玩法过于单一有点枯燥。在这边我讲一下钓鱼技巧。
1.该游戏前期可以在贝蒂湖攒钱，攒够以后去贝加尔湖畔钓大号鲟鱼（使用抖竿法能够快速的消耗鱼的体力:阻尼设置拉满，钓到鱼的时候按住左键不松手，并且狂点右键，如果下方进度条闪红的时候，松开鼠标左键之后按下鼠标中键关闭阻尼器。反复几次就能快速的消耗大鱼的体力，能起到小竿钓大鱼的作用）
2.游戏里一些鱼能够吃各式各样的鱼饵，但是每个种类的鱼饵对鱼的吸引力是不同的，我的话一般都是肉食鱼类选鱼块，其他鱼类选蚂蚱。浮饵钓法就是把鱼钩甩在湖里等鱼上钩就行了，只有路亚和飞钓才需要不停的动鱼竿。上来鱼的大小只和鱼钩有关，想钓大鱼可以换成大鱼钩。（请注意飞钓中若虫配前端沉水线，干式配全浮线，饰带毛钩配全浮线，湿式配全沉线）
3.不是全部种类的鱼都会刷新在地图上的，有些种类的鱼只会生成在固定的地方，比如陶波湖的云斑鮰，日本的西太公鱼。如果发现有些鱼钓不到可以反复重新进图刷新。
4.如果你遇到一直不上鱼的情况，可以试试更改鱼钩大小，更换鱼饵也行（比如大西洋大海鲢虽然吃大小鱼块和活饵，但是我实验了好几次基本上没遇到咬鱼块的情况，使用活饵就上钩很快）采用路亚钓法，有些地图的鱼口很差，日本地图中即使大鱼与鱼钩适配，也要等几分钟鱼才能咬钩。
5.拖船雷达显示的点和鱼的长度有关而不是重量，有些地图的鱼长度和体型严重不匹配（如2m长的只有19kg的巨骨舌鱼，亚马逊地图该问题极其严重，该地图尽量换小钩。）在游玩时需注意。
6.保留选项是决定鱼是否保留在水族馆，不论你是否保留，鱼都会在展示馆展览其最大纪录的鱼。
7.海图无脑选择大鱼块拖钓就好了。该游戏中基本上浮钓能钓上所有鱼类，反而飞钓底钓之类的不太方便。但是路亚钓的话鱼钩区间很大，不用频繁的换鱼钩钓不同体型的鱼，个人感觉有时候上鱼会比浮钓快。
